    Bluetooth: hci_ldisc: Initialize hci_dev before open()
    
    The hci_dev struct hdev is referenced in work queues and timers started

bic_trace_step.reason: The commit moves the proto->open() call from hci_uart_set_proto() to hci_uart_register_dev() after hdev is allocated and initialized.
